signatures.description: The selected Android device was unavailable before the flow could run.
signatures.action: Restore the emulator or device connection and rerun the same flow before changing app code.

signatures.description: Fixture cleanup sent an empty JSON request body that the backend rejected.

match.logsRegex: Body cannot be empty when content-type is set to application/json

signatures.action: Fix the fixture cleanup request so it either sends a valid JSON body or omits the JSON content type.

signatures.description: Login submission reached the backend but was rejected as unauthorized.
signatures.action: Inspect the login request payload and fixture credentials against the backend authentication contract.

signatures.description: The flow submitted login but remained on the sign-in screen.
signatures.action: Inspect the editable-field selectors and confirm input reached both email and password fields before submission.

signatures.description: A Maestro ID assertion failed and the expected ID was absent from the captured hierarchy.

match.failureRegex: Assertion is false: id: .* is visible

signatures.action: Compare the asserted ID with the app semantics/key definition and the changed Maestro selector before editing navigation or business logic.

signatures.description: A selector assertion failed while a Maestro flow file changed.
signatures.action: Inspect the changed Maestro selector against the captured hierarchy and restore the exact ID or full-text regex expected by the app.
